translation: Flavor bitter, non-toxic. It mainly treats the five kinds of exhaustion and seven kinds of damage [五勞七傷] in men, and damage to the center, uterine leakage [胞漏] and downflow of blood in women; it breaks malignant blood and blood in the urine, frees and removes old food in the stomach, [treats] exhaustion of strength and severance, supplements internal damage and insufficiency of the five viscera, frees the blood vessels, boosts qi and strength, and benefits the ears and eyes.
